headline: Indian markets open following strong rally driven by record FII buying and key corporate deals

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Indian stock market extended a 4-week rally with Sensex and Nifty reaching 9-month highs on record FII buying.
India decoupled from global market weakness as Sensex soared near 700 points and Nifty surpassed 25,700.
Global AI sell-off and US Federal Reserve rate hike signals created intermittent market volatility.
Investor interest remains active around key corporate deal announcements and stock-specific actions.
whatHappening: Tata Steel announced a massive ₹28,000 crore deal with APL Apollo Tubes for two units.
The Federation of Indian Pilots wrote to the Civil Aviation Minister concerning the SpiceJet crisis.
FSSAI sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri over alleged unsafe water samples.
Traders are watching stocks including Waaree Energies, Berger Paints, Blue Dart, Raymond, and Indian Bank.
summary: Indian markets are open today following recent strength that saw benchmarks hit multi-month highs on FII inflows. Major corporate announcements include a ₹28,000 crore transaction between Tata Steel and APL Apollo Tubes. SpiceJet also remains under scrutiny following communications from the pilots' federation.
